workspacePath.description: The canonical workspace path, recorded for the owner to read; the identity is what is compared.

receipt.description: The spent owner receipt that confirmed it.

PipelineAdoptionEnvelope.description: sentinel-pipeline-adoption/draft-1 — the owner's adoption of one pipeline for one workspace, kept in the owner's trust folder outside every checkout. `digest` covers the pipeline file's bytes and every pinned pack's bytes; a changed byte in either is no longer adopted.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 content address, lower-case hex.

Id.description: A ledger identifier. Opaque, bounded and free of path separators and whitespace.

Ordinal.description: A positive integer ordinal or revision.

PipelinePackPin.description: One stage or skill pack a pipeline names, by the digest of its referenced bytes at adoption.

PackRef.description: A file inside a promoted stage pack, `stages/<id>@<revision>#<file>`, or a whole skill pack, `skills/<id>@<revision>`. The pipeline's digest covers the referenced bytes, so a changed prompt is a new pipeline.

Timestamp.description: A UTC RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit Z offset and a real calendar date (no leap second), years 0000–9999 proleptic Gregorian, up to nine fractional digits. The pattern bounds each field; the `date-time` format check refuses a day the month does not have. Comparisons keep all nine digits.
